names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 26 iulie, «Sfântul Iacob Netsvetov din Alaska», with the rank word left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 26 Ιουλίου, «Όσιος Ιάκωβος ο εν Αλάσκα», with the rank word and the byname left off. The page glosses the name as a Hebrew word, the victor.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «S-a născut în 1802, în Insula Atka din Alaska, fiind fiul unui tată rus și al unei mame aleute.» The page gives no year for his death. saint.gr's head line agrees: «Οσιος Ιακωβος ο Εν Αλασκα (1802 - 1864)».

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Οσιος Ιακωβος ο Εν Αλασκα (1802 - 1864)». The head line is the whole of the year's warrant: the body of the notice says «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγίου», and doxologia, from which the folder was first written, gave no year of death at all.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 26 iulie — «Sfântul Iacob Netsvetov din Alaska»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιος Ιάκωβος ο εν Αλάσκα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and it heads him «Οσιος Ιακωβος ο Εν Αλασκα (1802 - 1864)» — the same birth year the folder holds off doxologia, and the same Alaska. The corpus keeps no other Jacob of Alaska. The Greek notice has no life to give — «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγίου» — but its head line carries the year of death that the Romanian page did not give, so this upgrade proposes a `dates` object repeating the folder's existing `birth` verbatim and adding a `death` of 1864. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn and no distich.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
